description: Logging a full PAN must be caught as a high-severity PCI finding (moved from security-reviewer, retired 2026-10-21)
rubric: PASS only if the review flags that the full PAN (card.pan) is written to logs as a CRITICAL or HIGH severity finding, citing that PAN must never be logged (PCI-DSS), and suggests removing/masking it. Rating this merely LOW/MEDIUM or missing it is a FAIL.
